To maximize human productivity. We started ClickUp because the way the world works is broken: teams juggle dozens of disconnected tools that slow them down. We built one converged platform to replace them all. Today, we're at the inflection point where software, AI, and humans come together, and our mission is to fundamentally reinvent how work gets done, not by making people work harder, but through the convergence of everything. What's ClickUp's financial health / is the company stable? ClickUp is one of the fastest-growing companies in SaaS. We surpassed $300M+ in annual recurring revenue and serve 20M+ users worldwide, with 800K+ new team signups every month. We're backed by $535M in funding from leading investors like Andreessen Horowitz, Tiger Global, and others. AI is where things get interesting: 400%+ AI sales growth year-to-date, AI usage up 800% YoY, and deals that include AI are 7× larger on average. Over 50% of our customers already use 5+ ClickUp apps, which means people aren't just trying us, they're consolidating their entire stack here. ClickUp is the world's first Converged AI Workspace, bringing together all work apps, data, and workflows. ClickUp eliminates all forms of work sprawl to provide 100% context and a single place for humans and agents to work, together. What is ClickUp's culture like? We're a product-led company that ships fast and iterates constantly. Our culture values ownership, speed, and craftsmanship. Teams are lean and cross-functional, which means individuals have outsized impact. We run on transparency, where company metrics, strategy, and decisions are shared openly. Working at ClickUp Is ClickUp remote-friendly? Yes. ClickUp has team members across multiple countries, and our work model varies by role and location. Some teams are fully remote, while others follow a hybrid schedule with in-office days. Specific expectations are noted in each job posting so you'll know upfront what applies. Regardless of model, we lean heavily on async collaboration through our own product and invest in meaningful in-person experiences. Where are ClickUp's offices? ClickUp is headquartered in San Diego, California, with a European HQ in Dublin, Ireland. We also have offices in San Francisco, California and London, United Kingdom, among other locations. Any hybrid or location requirements are noted in the job posting. We offer a co-working program for remote employees who want access to flexible workspace near them. What is work-life balance like at ClickUp? We're a high-growth company that values hard work and impact, and we're transparent about that. At the same time, we prioritize flexibility and trust our team to manage their time effectively. Our engagement surveys consistently show that employees feel supported by their managers, whether it's for personal appointments or family commitments. We also have initiatives like surprise wellness days to encourage balance and recharge. What benefits does ClickUp offer? ClickUp offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the whole person. Our core benefits include: comprehensive health plans, retirement savings, generous paid time off, paid parental leave, an enhanced employee assistance program (EAP), an employee wellness stipend, a professional development stipend, remote work flexibility, company-wide wellness days, and employee recognition programs. Benefits vary by location, and your recruiter can share the full details for your region during the interview process. Does ClickUp support career growth and development? Yes. One of our core values is 'Grow 1%', and we invest in growth at all levels. ClickUp offers an annual professional development stipend for courses, certifications, and conferences; an LMS with Harvard Business courses and accredited continuing education; and a leadership program for aspiring and current leaders. Every role sits on a clear career pathway with defined level expectations for both IC and management tracks, and internal mobility is actively encouraged. Some of our most successful crew members started as front-line representatives and are now product managers, leaders, and so much more! What tech stack does ClickUp use? TypeScript, Angular, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, and AWS. Our mobile apps are built with Flutter. Engineers work on real-scale problems: our platform serves 20M+ users globally. How does ClickUp approach diversity, equity, and inclusion? ClickUp is committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We support employee-led community groups (Employee Growth Groups) focused on mentorship, networking, and professional development, each with executive sponsorship and open to all as members or allies. Our recruiting practices are designed to be inclusive from first touchpoint through offer, and we continuously evaluate our processes to reduce bias and broaden access. Applying to ClickUp What is the interview process at ClickUp? Our interview process varies by team and role, but typically includes a recruiter screen, a hiring manager conversation, a skills-based assessment, and team conversations (either a panel or a series of 1:1s). Your recruiter will walk you through the specific steps and timeline for your process upfront. Can I apply for multiple roles at the same time? Yes, you're welcome to apply to more than one role. However, we recommend a targeted approach. A few well-matched applications carry far more weight than a high volume of generic ones, so focus on the positions that genuinely align with your skills and experience, and tailor each application accordingly. Once you apply, your profile is in our system, and our talent team may reach out if we spot a great fit for you down the line. Can I reapply after being rejected, and how long should I wait? Yes, you can reapply. We ask that you wait at least six months before reapplying to the same role, which gives you time to build new skills or experience. In the meantime, you're welcome to explore and apply to different roles at any time. Does ClickUp offer internships or early-career programs? We do not currently offer a formal internship program. However, we hire for entry-level and early-career roles across multiple teams. We recommend keeping an eye on our open positions and applying when you see a role that matches your skills and interests. Do I need work authorization for my position? Yes, candidates are required to have work authorization for the country they are applying for. Does ClickUp offer visa sponsorship? ClickUp is able to consider visa sponsorship for engineering and product roles on a case-by-case basis, depending on business needs for the specific position. We are typically unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for roles outside of engineering and product at this time. If you have questions about a specific role's eligibility, your recruiter can clarify early in the process. How do I request accommodations during the interview process? We're committed to providing an accessible and equitable interview experience for all candidates. If you have questions or need an accommodation in the recruitment process, please contact us at AskPeople@ClickUp.com . Contact us Can I upgrade myself or do I have to upgrade my entire Workspace? To upgrade ClickUp, you'll need to upgrade your entire Workspace, which means all members in your Workspace. What payment methods do you accept? We accept all major credit cards! For Enterprise orders meeting a minimum we also accept bank transfers. What is your refund policy? We have a 100% satisfaction guarantee. If for any reason, you're not satisfied with your purchase, simply let us know within 30 days and we'll be happy to issue you a full refund. How am I billed when I add paid users to a Workspace? ClickUp automatically bills you at a prorated price based on the time left in your cycle for any paid users added to your Workspace. Paid users include any member role types and people invited to your Workspace from within your organization. What if I have multiple Workspaces? Payment is per Workspace, meaning each Workspace requires an individual upgrade. What happens if I cancel? You're free to cancel at anytime! When you do, your current plan will last until the end of your billing cycle, unless you choose to downgrade immediately. Do you offer discounts for nonprofits, students, educators, or startups? Yes to all of the above! Check out the resources below for more information: For nonprofits, head to this link and click the 'Claim your nonprofit discount' button to get started For students, educators, and administrators, head to this link and click the 'Claim your academic discount' button to get started For startups, fill out and submit this form to apply for a startup credit, or head to this page for more info Do you have a public roadmap? We certainly do! You can find it here . Is the Free Forever Plan really free? For sure! This is so much more than a trial. The Free Forever Plan offers an unmatched level of functionality compared to other 'freemium' apps. We do this by making money on our paid plans. How do I change my plan if I start on the Free Forever Plan? Once you've created a team, we built a handy billing area to take care of all plan, cycle, and payment details. Do tasks count against my storage? No! File attachments are the only things that affect your team's storage. What is a 'use' in context of ClickUp's plans? 'Uses' are intended as a demonstration of paid plan features, allowing you to explore their value for your workflows. Uses are cumulative throughout a Workspace and they do not reset or count down. When you reach a use limit, you won't lose any data, but you won't be able to edit or create new items with that feature. You can find a breakdown which features have usage limits here . What happens when I hit my usage limits? You'll still be able to use ClickUp, and we'll let you know as soon as a limit is reached. We're happy to provide a grace period to find the plan that works for you! Does adding Guests to my Workspace affect my plan or how I'm billed? Free Forever Workspaces can have an unlimited number of members and guests at no charge. On the Free Forever Plan, guests have full create and edit permissions, which cannot be modified. Workspaces on a paid plan start with a limited number of external guest seats and unlimited read-only guests. The paid plan guest seats are as follows: Unlimited Plan: receive 5 guest seats for a 1 paid user Workspace and 2 guest seats for each additional paid user you invite to your Workspace Business Plan: receive 10 guest seats for a 1 paid user Workspace and 5 guest seats for each additional paid user you invite to your Workspace Enterprise Plan: receives the same number of guest seats as the Business Plan, with advanced permissions options Guests are intended for users external to your organization. If you add people from inside your organization to your Workspace, they will be billed as paid users. Head to this Support Doc to learn more about guest seats and guest permissions.
